findings.title: day_7 marks sent_at then lets the send error propagate, so ANY transient Resend error permanently loses the drip and attempt 2 no-ops to completed — no durable failure record anywhere
findings.reason: The marker is deliberately NOT rolled back (EmailSendTimeoutError fires while the orphaned fetch may still deliver, so a rollback would re-send). The silence was the defect, not the loss. The catch now calls markOutboxFailed with 'send failed after mark: <reason>' and returns; the keyed path still rethrows so BullMQ can legitimately retry. Two tests pin both halves.

findings.title: The owner-nudge swallow leaves no durable failure record: outbox already completed, markOutboxFailed no-ops, no BullMQ failed event, only logger.error
findings.reason: Now writes insertFailedDelivery(template 'owner_nudge') in the catch. Durable, names the reason, and does not delay the next nudge because the cooldown probe keys on sent_at IS NOT NULL. Test: 'records a failed delivery when an owner-nudge send fails'.
